entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I hope you can help me. I'm a bit lost with all this. I bought a jersey a while back, and I think I need to send it back. I'm just not sure how.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you happen to have your order number handy?
Um, yes, I think so. It's... VF-8675309. I just don't understand the website. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. I've pulled up your order now. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
It's just the wrong size. I thought it would fit, but it's much too tight across the shoulders. I waited too long, I think... I'm so confused by all the rules.
I see. So it's a sizing issue, and you're looking to possibly exchange it for a different size?
Yes, an exchange would be perfect! If that's allowed. I'm just so overwhelmed.
Let me check the policy for you. I can see the jersey was delivered about 53 days ago. One moment...
Okay, I have good news. You're well within our 90-day return window for standard items. We can definitely process this for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So you can help me? I don't have to figure it out myself?

Absolutely. I'm going to email you a pre-paid return label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package with the jersey inside, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we can either issue a full refund or process that exchange for the correct size. Which would you prefer?
The exchange, please. A size up would be great. Thank you so much, David. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. I've sent that email and put a note on your account for the exchange. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
